title: Bar Chart
instructions: Create a bar chart showing average `mpg` by `cyl` group. Use `stat = "identity"` and fill by cylinder count. Add a horizontal line at `mpg = 20` using `geom_hline()`.
starterCode:
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

mtcars |>
  group_by(cyl) |>
  summarise(avg_mpg = mean(mpg)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(cyl), y = avg_mpg, fill = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ___, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Cylinders", y = "Average MPG", title = "Average MPG by Cylinder Count")
